hermes.goal: Beat buy-and-hold (positive alpha vs BTC) while keeping max drawdown under 15% and never risking the mandate on a single trade — capital preservation first. Near-term: prove a sustained, fee-aware, positive out-of-sample edge on the paper trainer over ~90 days before scaling any live capital; grow the live account only on demonstrated alpha.

brain.commentary: Cross-asset stress and elevated institutional advisory risk warrant materially reduced aggregate exposure. BTC is the relative quality and liquidity anchor, but its modest signal does not overcome regime risk. ETH has elevated beta and volatility; SOL and LTC are fragile due negative alpha, composites, and weak factor/liquidity support. XRP is especially fragile because zero volatility and expected shortfall appear non-informative or data-artifact driven; do not rely on its long signal.
